weaknesses.title: REPLACEALL rejects bare numeric vars as third arg (unknown form)
weaknesses.detail: SYS REPLACEALL hay old pick_n where pick_n is numeric fails parse: unknown form 'pick_n'. Must SYS STR pick_n → string first. Same class for any host form expecting string when given num-typed var without quote/STR.
weaknesses.repro: LET n=3; SYS REPLACEALL 'X' 'X' n → unknown form 'n'

weaknesses.title: SYS PICK empty is soft OK=0 LAST_N=-1 — easy to miss without REQUIRE
weaknesses.detail: Empty roster page continues unless program checks LINES/OK. Good soft path but agents may log empty WHO if they skip OK check.

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON collapses roster and SEQ/IOTA bags
weaknesses.detail: Roster carolalicedave; SEQ 4 → "1234". History log also collapses. Scalars + plate files required.
weaknesses.repro: PRINT_JSON bag after seed; PRINT_JSON SEQ 4

weaknesses.title: No string concat — page log lines via REPLACEALL template
weaknesses.detail: TS|WHO|IDX built with REPLACEALL; names containing placeholders corrupt. Plus W1 STR shuttle for index.

weaknesses.title: GREP substring false friends on pure name roster
weaknesses.detail: GREP 'ali' matches alice; HASLINE 'ali' correctly 0. Identity is HASLINE/COUNTLINE exact only.
weaknesses.repro: GREP ali on alice → n=1; HASLINE ali → 0

weaknesses.title: WRITE roster often omits final trailing newline
weaknesses.detail: cat -A last name without $. APPEND log lines do get NL between entries.

weaknesses.title: PICK non-determinism and CUBALC_SEED only before first srand
weaknesses.detail: Agents cannot reseed mid-process easily; page wheel not reproducible across separate runs without env seed before any RAND/PICK in process. Documented in proof.
weaknesses.repro: CUBALC_SEED=42 only if srand not yet called

weaknesses.title: UNIQ only adjacent — needs SORT first for seed dedup
weaknesses.detail: Program SORT then UNIQ after seed. UNIQ alone leaves non-adjacent dups if seed path skipped HASLINE.

workarounds: Always SYS STR before REPLACEALL when substituting numbers
Check SYS LINES bag > 0 and PICK OK before APPEND log
HASLINE/COUNTLINE for identity — not GREP on names
SORT then UNIQ for bag dedup; or HASLINE on seed
PRINT_JSON only scalars (depth, log_n, pick); keep bags on plates
Set CUBALC_SEED before first RAND/PICK in process for repro
language_gaps: REPLACEALL (and string forms) should coerce numeric vars via STR automatically
PRINT_JSON newline escape for multi-line bags
UNIQ global (not only adjacent) or DEDUP form
issues_faced: First page path failed: REPLACEALL with pick_n numeric → unknown form — fixed with STR shuttle
Dead code first template block ran before rewrite — removed
PRINT_JSON SEQ/IOTA collapsed to 1234/0123 — still useful as weakness demo
